title: Incident responder answer
description: The machine-checkable answer an AI on-call pass produces for one bundle.

incident_id.description: The incident, spelled as the bundle directory names it.

summary.description: What the bundle shows, in plain prose. A two-word stub is not an answer.

classification.description: The subsystem the evidence points at; the list is closed.

severity.description: How bad the measured state is, on the pinned ladder.

root_cause_hypothesis.description: The most likely cause, stated as a hypothesis tied to the evidence.

evidence_refs.description: The bundle files this answer read; a ref may never escape the bundle.

actions_taken.description: The reads performed, plus the answer document; each entry needs a justification.

action.description: One of the six read-only actions; a policy-allow-list subset.

justification.description: The observation that made this read necessary.

confidence.description: How much the responder stands behind the hypothesis, from 0 to 1.

recovery_verified.description: Pinned to false: recovery is asserted only by the merged verification step.
